sql: WITH window_reviews AS (SELECT r.review_score FROM reviews.order_reviews r JOIN orders.orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN orders.order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN orders.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes' AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-02-01'), baseline_reviews AS (SELECT r.review_score FROM reviews.order_reviews r JOIN orders.orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN orders.order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN orders.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes' AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-12-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-01-01') SELECT ROUND(AVG(w.review_score), 4) AS value, ROUND(AVG(b.review_score), 4) AS baseline FROM window_reviews w CROSS JOIN baseline_reviews b;
